name: elagoht/gesso
description: A collage plugin that runs a gesso application's lifecycle: its modules start when collage starts serving and stop after collage's server has stopped.
setup: The plugin runs the gesso app collage mounts, so the app must reach both `plugins.go` and the mount. Build it in `newApp` before `collage.New` — `api, err := gesso.New(gesso.Config{BasePath: "/api"}, …)` — pass it in with `Plugins: plugins(api)`, and mount it after with `app.Handle("/api/", api)`. In `plugins.go` the framework needs another name than this plugin's `gesso`: `import gessoapp "github.com/Elagoht/gesso"`, `func plugins(api *gessoapp.App) []collage.Plugin`, and list `gesso.New(gesso.Options{App: api})`. Without an app, startup fails.
